SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Part V, Line 4: Intended uses of the endowment fund.
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The Organizations spending policy ensures that the amount of endowment income available to support the Organizations operations increases at a stable and predictable pace, while seeking to maintain the purchasing power of the endowment assets. The Organizations endowment funds are invested in U.S. Treasury securities, which is structured for long-term total return. After the endowment reaches $100,000, the Organizations spending policy is to disburse 5% annually, as long as the principal balance does not fall below the principal contributed.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Part I, Line 2 - Grantmakers Explanation For Monitoring Use of Funds Outside US
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION PROVIDES GRANTS TO OTHER ROTARY CLUBS THAT SHARE THE SAME MISSION. THE FUNDS ARE USED FOR SPECIFIC PURPOSES THAT THE INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS HAS APPLIED FOR. THE LEADERSHIP FOLLOWS UP WITH THE INTERNATIONAL CLUBS TO ENSURE THE FUNDS ARE SPENT ACCORDING TO THE GRANT APPLICATION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: PART V, LINE M: PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: WHILE MOST OF THE SERVICES REQUIRED BY THE FOUNDATION ARE PERFORMED BYVOLUNTEERS OR BY OUTSIDE PROVIDERS WHO BILL THE FOUNDATION DIRECTLY, SOME ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES ARE FULFILLED BY THE CLUBS TWO EMPLOYEES.

THE FOUNDATION REIMBURSES THE CLUB FOR COPIER AND POSTAGE METER USAGE.IN ADDITION, CERTAIN VENDORS SUBMIT BILLS TO THE CLUB THAT INCLUDECHARGES FOR GOODS AND SERVICES RELATED TO THE FOUNDATION. THESE COSTSARE REIMBURSED TO THE CLUB AT THEIR COST.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: PART V, LINE R: OTHER TRANSFERS
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: OCCASIONALLY, MEMBERS WILL MAKE CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE CLUB, BUTUNINTENTIONALLY INCLUDE THEM WITH PAYMENT DUE TO THE FOUNDATION FOR ANYDUES FOR ACTIVITIES AND SERVICES. THE FOUNDATION TRANSFERS ANY SUCHAMOUNTS BACK TO THE CLUB.
